items.title: MAHA health adviser Calley Means resigns from Trump administration
items.feedTitle: RFK Jr. adviser Calley Means resigns amid growing MAHA discontent over lack of progress
items.summary: Calley Means, a top adviser to Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and chief advocate for the Make America Healthy Again (MAHA) movement, resigned from his Trump administration position Thursday. Means' departure signals growing discontent within the MAHA movement over lack of progress on its health agenda. The resignation comes as the health overhaul initiative faces implementation delays and internal friction.

items.title: Federal judge blocks DHS noncitizen voter identification effort
items.feedTitle: DOJ monitoring plans and DHS voter checks raise concerns of election interference
items.summary: A federal judge in California has blocked a Department of Homeland Security effort to identify noncitizens on voter rolls, raising concerns about federal election interference just weeks before midterms. The ruling questions the legality of the federal government's role in policing voter eligibility and reflects broader tensions over election administration and voting access.

items.title: Oregon teacher wounded in school shooting describes attack
items.feedTitle: Teacher injured in Oregon school shooting says she had no chance to protect students
items.summary: A teacher injured in a special education classroom attack at an Oregon elementary school said she had no opportunity to protect students because of the severity of her injuries. The statement, issued through a family friend, marks the first public account from a survivor of last week's incident and raises questions about school safety protocols.

items.title: Virginia state senator indicted in marijuana business investigation
items.feedTitle: Virginia state Sen. L. Louise Lucas indicted in connection with marijuana business
items.summary: Virginia state Sen. L. Louise Lucas, a powerful Democrat, was indicted in connection with running a criminal marijuana enterprise, according to federal authorities. The charges against the influential lawmaker involve the acquisition, distribution, and money laundering of large quantities of cannabis. Her indictment marks a significant political development as the state legislator faces federal prosecution.

items.title: Supreme Court upholds New Hampshire student ID voting ban
items.feedTitle: Supreme Court says New Hampshire student IDs can’t be used to vote in November
items.summary: The Supreme Court on Thursday ruled that New Hampshire's top election official can fully block voters from using student IDs at polls during the midterms, backing a Republican National Committee request. The decision overturned a lower court finding that officials had improperly exceeded their authority. The ruling narrows voting access options just weeks before the election.

stlouis.title: Missouri governor questions SLMPD chief contract process
stlouis.feedTitle: Kehoe questions process behind new contract for SLMPD Chief
stlouis.summary: Missouri Governor Kehoe raised concerns about the process behind a new contract for St. Louis Metropolitan Police Department Chief, saying the police board received 'bad advice' on the agreement. The controversy centers on contract negotiations and governance procedures at the city's top law enforcement agency during an election season.

stlouis.title: Man admits setting metro-east spa fires after sexual encounter
stlouis.feedTitle: Man burned down Metro East massage parlor, killing woman inside, over sexual encounter, investigators say
stlouis.summary: A St. Louis man has admitted to federal authorities that he set fires at metro-east massage parlors following a sexual encounter, resulting in at least one death. The ATF-documented confession reveals a serious arson spree motivated by personal conflict. The case highlights ongoing security issues in the region's spa businesses.

stlouis.title: MetroLink extension to airport nears completion
stlouis.feedTitle: Construction Wraps Up on $192M MetroLink Extension to MidAmerica St. Louis Airport
stlouis.summary: Construction is wrapping up on a $192 million MetroLink extension to MidAmerica St. Louis Airport, a major regional transit project. The extension represents significant investment in public transportation infrastructure connecting the airport to the broader St. Louis transit system.

items.title: Tibet earthquake kills 16, injures 32 in China's western region
items.feedTitle: Earthquake of magnitude 7 strikes China's Tibet, killing 16, Xinhua reports
items.summary: A powerful 7.0-magnitude earthquake struck China's Tibet region Thursday, killing 16 people and injuring 32 others, according to Xinhua. The quake collapsed hundreds of homes and caused widespread destruction across the mountainous area. Emergency response efforts are ongoing as authorities assess the full extent of damage.

items.title: Serbian student-led rally challenges Vučić's 12-year rule before election
items.feedTitle: Massive student-led rally marches in Belgrade ahead of Serbian election
items.summary: About 150,000 supporters of Serbia's opposition student-led List movement rallied in central Belgrade ahead of Sunday's pivotal election aimed at ousting President Aleksandar Vučić. The massive demonstration reflects two years of sustained student protests against the long-ruling government. The election represents a critical test of whether the opposition can end Vučić's 12-year political dominance.

items.title: Super Typhoon Champi heads toward Taiwan, Japan, China with heavy rains
items.feedTitle: Typhoon Champi roars towards Taiwan, Japan and China bringing heavy rain and wind
items.summary: Typhoon Champi, already one of 2026's strongest storms, is roaring toward Taiwan, Japan, and China with heavy rain and destructive winds. The super typhoon poses significant threats to the densely populated regions in its path. Forecasters warn of severe impacts including flooding and landslides across multiple countries.

items.title: US and Israel plan renewed strikes on Iran after midterms
items.feedTitle: US and Israel drawing up plans to resume attacks on Iran post-election, sources say - ABC News
items.summary: U.S. and Israeli militaries are drafting plans to resume strikes on Iran following the American midterm elections, according to multiple sources. The planning suggests both nations may pursue renewed military action once U.S. domestic political calendars allow. The development raises concerns about potential escalation in regional tensions and broader Middle East conflict.
items.source: Breaking News, Latest News and Videos

items.title: Russia bombs Kyiv hours after agreeing to resume peace talks
items.feedTitle: Russia bombards Kyiv with missiles hours after agreeing to resume talks with Ukraine
items.summary: Russia carried out a massive demonstrative attack on Ukraine, bombarding Kyiv with ballistic missiles just hours after Vladimir Putin said Russia had agreed to resume peace talks with the U.S. and Ukraine. The contradiction between diplomatic signals and military action suggests Russia is attempting to destroy energy infrastructure before winter while appearing open to negotiations. Experts warn such tactics undermine genuine peace prospects.

items.title: YouTuber arrested after popular Indian finance influencer's suicide
items.feedTitle: YouTuber arrested after popular Indian finance influencer's suicide
items.summary: A YouTuber has been arrested in connection with the death of V. Harish, the hugely popular 'Finance with Harish' Instagram influencer who was found dead Tuesday. The arrest marks a development in the investigation into the influencer's suicide, which had drawn widespread attention across India's financial social media community. Details remain limited as authorities continue their inquiry.

items.title: PM Modi backs Ukraine peace efforts in Poland talks
items.feedTitle: Will back all meaningful efforts for Ukraine peace, PM Modi assures Poland's Tusk
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi assured Poland's Prime Minister Donald Tusk that India will back all meaningful efforts toward achieving peace in Ukraine during bilateral talks in New Delhi. Modi emphasized India's commitment to diplomatic resolution of the conflict. The talks reaffirm India's role as a neutral mediator in the ongoing war.

items.title: Indian dies in Saudi airport Houthi strike; MEA condemns
items.feedTitle: Indian dies in Saudi airport strike; MEA slams infrastructure attacks
items.summary: An Indian national was killed in a Houthi attack on a Saudi Arabian airport, prompting India's Ministry of External Affairs to condemn the strike on civilian infrastructure. The death marks the first confirmed Indian casualty in recent regional military escalations. India called for restraint and protection of civilian lives in the ongoing Middle East tensions.

items.title: UP voter list plagued by bizarre name errors and glitches
items.feedTitle: ‘Ram Ne Yadav Ko Mara’, ‘Murkhchand Yadav’: UP voter list reads like a comedy script, but EC not amused
items.summary: Irregularities in Uttar Pradesh's voter rolls have resulted in bizarre entries with names like 'Ram Ne Yadav Ko Mara' (Ram killed Yadav) and 'Murkhchand Yadav' (Fool Yadav), prompting legal action against poll officials. The Election Commission found glitches affecting over 10,000 voter entries and suspended two poll officials. The errors raise concerns about electoral integrity and administrative oversight.

items.title: PM Modi hails India's historic 85-medal Asian Para Games haul
items.feedTitle: "Achieved several milestones for the first time": PM Modi hails India's historic 85-medal haul at Asian Games 2026
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi praised India's unprecedented performance at the 2026 Asian Para Games, where the country achieved its historic 85-medal tally. Modi highlighted several milestones achieved for the first time, underscoring India's growing strength in Paralympic sports. The medal count reflects significant investment in adaptive sports and athlete development.

immigration.title: Trump administration finalizes H-1B extension restrictions, ends deference
immigration.feedTitle: Trump Administration Moves to End H-1B Extension Protections, Finalizes Restrictions on Work Permit Renewals
immigration.summary: The Trump administration has finalized restrictions ending deference to prior approvals for H-1B visa extensions and related work permits, effective and in force. The policy removes long-standing practice of automatically approving renewal petitions based on prior approvals, forcing employers to re-establish eligibility. The change will increase scrutiny and processing times for Indian tech workers seeking visa renewals and puts H-4 EAD holders at risk of work authorization gaps.

immigration.title: US suspends PERM labor certification for eight major tech firms
immigration.feedTitle: US Suspends PERM Labor Certification for Eight Tech Giants, Blocking Green Card Pathway for Indian H-1B Holders
immigration.summary: The Trump administration has suspended Permanent Labor Certification (PERM) program applications for eight technology companies, including Microsoft and Adobe, effectively blocking the green card pathway for their H-1B workers. The suspension, finalized and in effect, targets firms allegedly engaged in H-1B abuse and displacing American workers. The ban prevents Indian tech workers at these companies from advancing toward permanent immigration status.

immigration.title: Over 300,000 visas revoked in Trump's second-term vetting crackdown
immigration.feedTitle: Trump Visa Revocations Surge Past 300,000 as Crackdown Accelerates
immigration.summary: The State Department has revoked over 300,000 visas under the Trump administration's expanded immigration vetting crackdown, finalized and ongoing. The mass revocations include social media screening extended to professionals and journalists and reflect broad application of security and fraud investigations. The scale represents one of the largest visa revocation campaigns in U.S. history and directly affects international workers including Indian visa holders.

items.title: Nasdaq posts worst day since June as AI spending doubts resurface
items.feedTitle: S&P 500, Nasdaq end sharply lower as revived AI doubts ignite tech selloff
items.summary: The Nasdaq closed sharply lower Thursday, posting its worst day in four months as investors grew weary of elevated AI capital expenditure and mounting debt concerns. Meta's post-earnings guidance spooked markets, and Jensen Huang's remarks about capital shortages fueled financing anxiety. The broad tech selloff pulled the S&P 500 down alongside the Nasdaq, ending a multi-day losing streak for major indices.

items.title: Oil prices surge to five-month high amid Iran tensions
items.feedTitle: Sharp drops for AI stocks overwhelm markets worldwide as oil prices jump
items.summary: Oil prices jumped to their highest level since May Thursday, climbing above $113 per barrel, driven by concerns over potential U.S.-Israel strikes on Iran after the midterm elections. Attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz and a Houthi strike on Saudi infrastructure amplified supply-risk premiums. The surge in crude is weighing on global markets and pressuring equity investors already nervous about AI spending.

items.title: Indian markets fall for third straight day amid oil surge
items.feedTitle: Sensex Falls 460 Points, Nifty Drops Below 22,700 as Rising Oil Prices Extend Market Losing Streak
items.summary: India's Sensex shed 460 points Thursday and the Nifty 50 closed below 22,700, marking the third consecutive session of losses as crude oil prices topped $112. Weak market breadth and elevated geopolitical risks over the Iran situation weighed on domestic equities. The rupee snapped an eight-day winning streak as foreign investor confidence wavered on global growth concerns.

items.title: Jio IPO sees overwhelming day-one demand amid market volatility
items.feedTitle: Jio IPO Sees Overwhelming Demand on Day One Even as Indian Stocks Struggle
items.summary: Mukesh Ambani's Jio Platforms IPO, potentially India's biggest-ever public offering, saw overwhelming demand on its first day despite broader Indian stock market weakness. The low-cost broadband provider aims for an £81 billion valuation as it taps investor appetite for digital infrastructure exposure. The strong reception contrasts with broader market pessimism driven by oil prices and AI spending concerns.

items.title: Barclays cuts 5,000 jobs citing AI productivity gains
items.feedTitle: Barclays to cut 5,000 jobs as bank’s bosses hail AI productivity advances
items.summary: Barclays announced 5,000 job cuts, representing 5% of its 93,000 global workforce, as part of wider cost-saving plans the bank says are driven by AI productivity advances. The job reductions coincide with the bank's announcement of a jump in quarterly profits. The move reflects broader financial services industry trends of using AI to reduce headcount and improve margins.

cards.title: Single-task mastery beats context-switching
cards.insight: Studies show task-switching costs the average worker 40% of productive time. Attention residue—the cognitive residue left when shifting tasks—degrades performance on both the task you left and the one you're starting. Deep focus on one meaningful task for 90 minutes produces higher-quality output than fragmented effort across six.
cards.takeaway: Block your calendar in 90-minute deep work sessions with notifications off. Protect the first two hours of your day for your most cognitively demanding work before context-switching begins.

cards.title: Energy management trumps time management
cards.insight: Productivity isn't about squeezing more hours—it's about matching task difficulty to your circadian and ultradian rhythms. Most people have two or three high-energy windows per day; using them on shallow work (email, meetings) wastes peak cognitive capacity. Low-energy periods are ideal for administrative tasks.
cards.takeaway: Map your energy patterns for one week by rating focus quality hourly. Schedule your most important work during your top-two energy windows; batch meetings and email into lower-energy blocks.

cards.title: Boredom is a feature, not a bug
cards.insight: When focus is constant and stimulation unrelenting, the brain never consolidates learning or generates novel insights. Boredom—brief periods without external input—activates the default mode network, the brain's reflection and creativity engine. Walking, commuting, or showering often yield breakthroughs because they're unstimulating.
cards.takeaway: Schedule 10 minutes of unstimulating activity (no phone, no input) between focus blocks. Use transitions—commutes, walks—deliberately as thinking time rather than filling them with podcasts.

cards.title: Finish lines create focus; open loops drain it
cards.insight: Incomplete tasks consume cognitive resources even when you're not thinking about them explicitly (the Zeigarnik effect). The brain treats unfinished work as unresolved and keeps it in working memory. Clear, defined endpoints—even arbitrary ones—signal completion to your brain and free attention.
cards.takeaway: Set specific, time-bound finish lines for every task: 'Draft the proposal by 3pm' beats 'work on proposal.' Use a daily shutdown ritual: list tomorrow's priorities, then close your laptop. This signals completion to your brain.

ai.title: OpenAI nears $30B funding round at $1.25T valuation
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
ai.summary: OpenAI is closing in on a new funding round valued at approximately $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion company valuation, led by UAE investors. The round would make OpenAI the most highly valued private company ever, surpassing previous records. The funding, finalized but pending completion, comes as OpenAI prepares for a potential IPO and intensifies competition with Anthropic and other AI leaders.

ai.title: Anthropic launches Claude Duet, new agentic AI application
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic Introduces Claude Duet: A New Agentic AI App for Professionals
ai.summary: Anthropic has introduced Claude Duet, a new agentic AI application that allows professionals to delegate tasks to AI agents that work autonomously while users are away. The app, available through waitlist for Pro and Max plan users, represents Anthropic's entry into the competitive agents market dominated by OpenAI. Claude Duet reflects broader industry shift toward autonomous AI systems capable of independent decision-making.

ai.title: Microsoft develops diagnostic AI tool matching doctor performance
ai.feedTitle: Microsoft develops AI tool that can diagnose 'sequentially' like a doctor
ai.summary: Microsoft has developed an AI diagnostic tool that can diagnose medical conditions sequentially, similar to how physicians approach diagnosis, and claims it outperforms generalist doctors on hard cases. According to a study in Science, the system beat human doctors in certain complex scenarios. The development aligns with Microsoft's broader push toward 'medical superintelligence' and raises questions about AI's role in healthcare delivery.
